baseline_models.focus_anchor: The emphatic causative verb and its cognate noun, يُدْخِلَنَّهُم مُّدْخَلًا, are evaluated by the entrants' own يَرْضَوْنَهُ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The doubled entry root makes both boundary-crossing and the resulting inside salient, while رضا tests the outcome from the entrants' side. The promise is therefore not bare survival or transfer but assured arrival into an inside they accept without resentment.

activation_trace.role: Literal passage into an interior supplies both the threshold crossed and the destination reached in the focus construction.
Acceptance in place of displeasure makes the recipients' settled approval the criterion of successful admission.
The second mapped رضا inventory independently preserves willing acceptance and prevents reducing the outcome to imposed placement.

changed_reading.before: They are promised an unspecified favorable destination.
changed_reading.after: They are assured a completed crossing into an interior whose adequacy is confirmed by their own durable acceptance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The cognate pair يُدْخِلَنَّهُم مُّدْخَلًا leaves manner and place live, and the clause closes with عَلِيمٌ حَلِيمٌ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Because the entry noun is unnamed beyond their satisfaction, it can carry both where they are placed and how the admission is accomplished. Complete knowledge supplies exact fit; restrained patience supplies timing and manner, so the promise covers a calibrated process as well as a destination.

activation_trace.role: Entry into a place, time, or undertaking keeps the cognate noun open to destination and mode at once.
Full disclosure to the knower supplies the epistemic basis for matching the admission to those admitted.
Self-command and patient restraint make delay and gentleness functional features of the way the promise is carried out.
Recipient acceptance is the observable result that joins correct placement to a fitting manner of arrival.

changed_reading.before: The verse names only the place awaiting them.
changed_reading.after: The verse promises a knowingly fitted and patiently timed admission, with manner and place deliberately left co-present.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The entry root can name an inward or confidential interior, while عَلِيمٌ and حَلِيمٌ govern what is known and how it is handled.
baseline_models.mechanism: A branch from physical inside to concealed inwardness allows the promised entry to include protected interior security. Divine knowledge reaches what is hidden without exposing it, and forbearance handles that inward condition without violent disclosure; رضا marks the resulting ease.

activation_trace.role: The concealed inward side of an affair extends spatial entry into protected interiority while remaining attached to the focus root.
Knowledge as disclosure to the knower lets the hidden condition be fully met without making public exposure the mechanism.
Restrained handling turns knowledge of the inward state into protection rather than immediate punitive reaction.
Willing acceptance registers the inward security produced by that protected handling.

changed_reading.before: Admission is a publicly legible relocation.
changed_reading.after: Admission may also secure a hidden inward condition that is completely known, gently handled, and finally at ease.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier worshipper remains on an edge: benefit gives temporary calm, but trial flips the person back upon the face. Against that unstable sequence, entering an inside and being pleased there reads as durable settlement after testing, not merely another favorable stimulus.

activation_trace.role: Crossing into an interior provides the focus-side opposite to remaining precariously at a boundary.
Acceptance supplies a stable terminal state rather than a mood contingent on the next event.
Directional deviation makes the exposed edge a functional image of allegiance liable to slip away.
Momentary stillness under benefit supplies the weaker, conditional calm that the focus satisfaction revises.
Turning a thing back upon its face gives the explicit reversal mechanism from which interior settlement differs.

structural_cues: 22:11 sequences edge, benefit-conditioned calm, trial, and reversal within one compact test.
22:59 couples emphatic admission with satisfaction and gives no subsequent reversal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an unstable edge-calm-reversal sequence and a later assured inside; I infer a contrast from conditional composure to durable settlement. A live alternative is that يرضونه marks reward pleasure only, without answering 22:11.

changed_reading.before: Their satisfaction is simply a pleasant response to reward.
changed_reading.after: Their satisfaction is also the stability of people brought off a reversible edge and settled within after trial.

context_deltas.mechanism: Twice the surah uses the same divine admission formula with gardens as its object. Those repetitions supply a strong garden horizon for the unnamed مُدْخَل of 22:59, while the focus replaces descriptive inventory with the entrants' satisfaction and thus foregrounds fit and arrival rather than scenery alone.

activation_trace.role: The focus repeats entry as its central action but leaves the interior unnamed, allowing contextual specification without erasing openness.
Acceptance shifts attention from an itemized destination to the entrants' experienced adequacy within it.
The first repeated causative admission establishes a concrete earlier use of the focus action.
A tree-covered garden supplies the sheltered destination paired with that earlier admission.
The second repetition reinforces admission into a specified inside as a stable surah-level pattern.
The repeated sheltered garden makes the contextual destination robust while leaving 22:59 free to stress fitting reception.

structural_cues: The divine-admission formula recurs at 22:14 and 22:23 with gardens explicitly named.
At 22:59 the cognate noun replaces a named object and is qualified by the recipients' satisfaction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two same-root admission-to-gardens formulas; I infer that they orient the ellipsis in 22:59 while its altered syntax intentionally foregrounds quality of entry. The live alternative is that مُدْخَل denotes a distinct mode or station and should not be exhausted by the garden parallels.

changed_reading.before: The promised entry has no contextual destination.
changed_reading.after: Gardens form its strongest spatial horizon, but 22:59 specifically advances from naming reward-space to promising an entry and fit satisfying to its recipients.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pilgrimage sequence moves from obstruction at the protected sanctuary to an appointed abode, a purified house, and circulation at the ancient or liberating house. It activates the focus entry as restored hospitality: those denied access are brought into a protected home-space where presence is legitimate and satisfying.

activation_trace.role: Admission into an inside anchors the sanctuary sequence back to the focus rather than leaving it as an independent ritual theme.
Recipient acceptance makes restored access feel like rightful hospitality rather than mere permission to cross.
A bounded sacred precinct supplies the protected spatial inside from which people had been obstructed.
Providing an abode turns sacred location into deliberately prepared lodging and supports an admission-as-hospitality mechanism.
Shelter and dwelling make the appointed sacred site a home-like destination rather than an abstract coordinate.
Return to the house at the ritual sequence's culmination supplies the arrival side of restored access.
Release from bondage adds an exploratory freedom-layer to the house, making entry the opposite of exclusion and constraint.

structural_cues: 22:25-29 moves from blocked sanctuary access through prepared house-space to completed circumambulation.
The sanctuary is made for people without privileging resident over visitor, sharpening the hospitality relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies obstruction, protected precinct, prepared abode, house, and ritual arrival; I infer that this sequence can model the later pleasing admission as restored hospitality. The alternative is that the pilgrimage house and the eschatological مُدْخَل remain only analogous, not mutually specifying.

changed_reading.before: Admission is entry into a private reward enclosure.
changed_reading.after: Admission can also be heard as rightful, protected homecoming after exclusion, with satisfaction arising from restored access and belonging.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those driven outward from their dwellings without right are next imagined as enabled in the land, with the outcome belonging to God. The focus causative admission reverses forced exit, so the pleasing place repairs dispossession by granting durable location and agency, not merely substituting one address for another.

activation_trace.role: Movement into an interior supplies the exact spatial counter-motion to the earlier forced movement out.
Their acceptance distinguishes restorative emplacement from another coerced relocation.
Passage to the outside supplies the displaced group's initiating spatial wound and the inverse of focus admission.
Affiliation with and residence in a dwelling identifies what forced exit severed and what satisfying entry can restore.
Empowerment turns regained place into capacity for ordered communal action rather than passive shelter alone.
The final outcome gives the expulsion-to-enablement sequence a directed terminus that the focus entry can complete.

structural_cues: 22:39-41 links being wronged, expulsion from dwellings, defense of worship-spaces, and possible empowerment in the land.
The focus later uses emphatic causative entry for people whose movement had been violently interrupted.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forced exit, lost dwellings, later empowerment, and final outcome; I supply the spatial reversal from أُخْرِجُوا to لَيُدْخِلَنَّهُم and the claim that empowerment belongs to repair. A live alternative is compensation in an entirely other realm without restoration imagery.

changed_reading.before: The promised place compensates victims by relocating them elsewhere.
changed_reading.after: The admission reverses coerced exit by restoring a durable inside and the agency that dispossession had removed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated pattern of extending time and then taking wrongdoers makes divine delay an administered interval rather than inattention. When 22:59 seals an emphatic future admission with Knowing and Forbearing, waiting can be read as measured restraint within fulfillment, not evidence that the promise has weakened.

activation_trace.role: Patient self-restraint anchors the temporal reading in the focus epithet and makes delay compatible with assured action.
Complete knowledge excludes ignorance as the cause of delay and supports deliberate timing.
The emphatically promised crossing remains the event whose timing is being re-read, keeping the temporal model focus-anchored.
An extended span of time supplies the first explicit instance of purposeful postponement.
The second mapped inventory specifies granting additional duration and confirms that the interval is actively given.
Accountability after wrongdoing supplies the decisive endpoint showing that extension is not abandonment of judgment.

structural_cues: 22:44 and 22:48 repeat the same postponement-then-taking sequence.
The future-emphatic admission in 22:59 is immediately qualified by knowledge and forbearance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies controlled postponement before decisive action; I infer that the same divine timing logic can govern delayed positive admission. The alternative is that حليم describes mercy alone and contributes no temporal nuance to مُدْخَلًا.

changed_reading.before: Forbearance is a general divine gentleness appended to the promise.
changed_reading.after: Forbearance explains how an admission can be certain yet patiently timed: the interval is administered, known, and internal to fulfillment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those given knowledge recognize truth and their hearts become low, still, and receptive. Activated through the focus branch of concealed interiority, the promised entry can include an inward arrival: truth settles in a heart whose agitation cools, so exterior placement and interior satisfaction need not be competing readings.

activation_trace.role: The hidden inward side of entry provides the focus anchor for treating reception within the heart as a layer of admission.
Willing acceptance supplies the affective result of inward settlement rather than mere cognitive assent.
Recognition that discloses what is true supplies the epistemic ingress leading into the heart's changed condition.
Stable correspondence with reality gives the entering content firmness rather than leaving it as passing impression.
A broad, quiet lowland supplies a spatial analogy for a heart becoming receptive and settled.
The non-dominant mapping's dying flame supplies a coexisting image of inward agitation cooling rather than being forcibly suppressed.
The heart is the explicit receiving interior in which knowledge, truth, humility, and eventual satisfaction can converge.

structural_cues: 22:52-54 moves from intrusive casting and removal to confirmed signs, recognized truth, belief, and humbled hearts.
22:59 combines entry, recipient satisfaction, divine knowledge, and restraint in one sentence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recognized truth and transformed hearts; I infer that the focus's inward-entry branch can carry this as an interior layer of the promised arrival. The live alternative is that 22:59 remains wholly locative and the heart sequence only characterizes its recipients beforehand.

changed_reading.before: Persons enter a satisfactory external location.
changed_reading.after: External arrival may coexist with an inward arrival in which truth finds a quiet, receptive interior and satisfaction becomes settled assent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate antecedent begins with departure from one abode toward another, places that movement on a path, interrupts it by killing or death, and promises an allotted good provision. The focus admission resumes the broken trajectory: God causes the travelers to arrive, and the satisfying مُدْخَل gives the promised provision the form of completed passage and reception.

activation_trace.role: Causative entry supplies the missing arrival that completes the immediately preceding journey.
The travelers' acceptance marks the completed arrival as repair rather than merely another displacement.
Departure from one abode toward another supplies an explicitly unfinished relocation whose arrival is absent until the focus.
A traversable extended path makes migration a directed route and lets admission function as its terminus.
Violent loss of life supplies one interruption that cannot cancel the route's divinely caused completion.
Loss of life by death supplies the nonviolent interruption and broadens the completion beyond one manner of dying.
An apportioned gift turns the focus destination and its reception into the concrete completion of the promised good provision.

structural_cues: 22:58 and 22:59 form one syntactic sequence: migrants, interrupted deaths, emphatic provision, then emphatic admission.
The move from هاجروا to ليدخلنهم supplies departure and arrival across the ayah boundary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies migration, route, interruption, provision, and then admission; I supply the arrow that admission completes the journey and embodies the provision. The alternative is a simple sequence of two independent rewards after death.

changed_reading.before: Admission is a reward added after the migrants' deaths.
changed_reading.after: Admission is the divinely completed arrival of a migration that killing or death interrupted, and the satisfying reception is the promised provision realized.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah moves through equivalent retaliation, renewed transgression, vindication of the wronged, pardon, and protective covering. Read back into حليم and the pleasing admission, this sequence makes the destination a de-escalated final state: injured people are not abandoned, but neither does reciprocal harm define the inside into which they are brought.

activation_trace.role: Disciplined restraint anchors the movement from justified response toward an end not governed by escalating anger.
Acceptance defines the restored condition reached after conflict rather than treating retaliation itself as the satisfying end.
The promised interior remains the final state into which the conflict sequence is resolved.
A consequence imposed after wrongdoing supplies the bounded retaliatory stage rather than an unconditioned appetite for revenge.
Equivalence limits response to a matching measure and forms the first brake on escalation.
Crossing the limit through aggression identifies the renewed wrong that calls for protection rather than endless symmetry.
Vindicating the wronged supplies active protection, so restraint does not collapse into neglect of injury.
Leaving punishment and effacing fault turns the sequence away from retaliation as its permanent organizing principle.
Covering fault and shielding its bearer supplies the protected aftermath in which a pleasing inside can remain habitable.

structural_cues: 22:60 follows the focus directly and sequences equivalence, renewed aggression, divine help, pardon, and forgiveness.
22:59 ends with restraint before 22:60 names a conflict in which restraint and vindication must coexist.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bounded retaliation followed by help, pardon, and covering; I infer a de-escalatory arrow back into حليم and the final admission. The alternative is that 22:60 begins a separate legal case and does not qualify the emotional or moral texture of 22:59.

changed_reading.before: The pleasing admission is straightforward payment to passive, morally uncomplicated victims.
changed_reading.after: The admission is a protected restorative end after morally entangled injury: justice is upheld, escalation is bounded, and reciprocal harm does not own the final state.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the focus, night is inserted into day and day into night with paired causatives. That reciprocal temporal image activates the focus branch of interpenetrating parts: admission may be a staged transition in which one condition enters another gradually, not only an instantaneous doorway event.

activation_trace.role: Interlocking and inwardly joined parts provide the focus-root basis for reading admission as overlap and integration rather than a bare threshold.
Patient restraint gives the proposed transition a gradual temporal character instead of abrupt replacement.
Acceptance supplies the endpoint by which a staged integration is judged complete.
Insertion of one thing into another supplies the adjacent parallel action and turns entry into reciprocal temporal transition.
The non-dominant mapping's thickening darkness preserves the night-side materiality and makes the overlap image vivid without controlling the reading.

structural_cues: 22:61 immediately follows the focus and repeats a causative insertion twice in reciprocal order.
Night into day and day into night present a transition whose boundary moves rather than a single door that opens once.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent reciprocal insertion of temporal states; I transfer that process-shape to the focus admission and infer gradual integration. The live alternative is that 22:61 is solely a cosmological proof and contributes no manner to مُدْخَلًا.

changed_reading.before: Admission is a one-time crossing of a fixed threshold.
changed_reading.after: Admission may be patiently staged and interleaved, like one temporal condition entering another, until the recipients are fully integrated and satisfied.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a livestock-watering subbranch rather than the ordinary locative sense. It remains anchored in the doubled focus entry root and is sharpened by the immediately preceding allotted provision and interrupted path; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for completing a deprived share, never as a literal claim about animals or water.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus repeats د خ ل in verb and noun, and one branch depicts re-admitting thirsty animals so drinking can be completed.

activation_trace.role: A remedial return to the watering place supplies the odd but exact image of re-entry arranged so an unmet need can finally be completed.
Acceptance marks the completion of deprivation and keeps the material analogy tied to the focus result.
The extended route supplies the travel condition in which access to sustenance had been interrupted.
An assigned share of provision turns the second-entry image into completion of what was due rather than repetition without purpose.

changed_reading.before: The migrants are simply moved into a final place.
changed_reading.after: Their admission can be pictured, cautiously, as remedial re-entry that lets interrupted travelers receive and complete their allotted share.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it uses the focus root's socially intrusive or incorporative branch and a remote closing context rather than the dominant place sense. It remains validly anchored by د خ ل, recipient رضا, explicit selection, removal of constriction, and holding fast; downstream prose should retain it as a possible belonging-layer alongside, not instead of, eschatological location.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A د خ ل branch concerns an entrant mixed into a people or their affairs, allowing the plural objects of admission to be heard socially as well as spatially.

activation_trace.role: An entrant incorporated among a group supplies a social-inside reading of the promised admission.
Willing acceptance distinguishes genuine belonging from alienating absorption into a group.
Selection that brings near supplies the social movement from outsider status toward chosen proximity.
Constriction supplies the excluded pressure explicitly removed from the collective identity into which incorporation is proposed.
Protective holding supplies cohesion and safety for the proposed collective inside.

changed_reading.before: Each person is admitted individually into a location.
changed_reading.after: A coexisting layer admits displaced people into protected, chosen belonging where incorporation is freely satisfying rather than constrictive.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates a concrete animal-tending use within ح ل م rather than the standard virtue of restraint. It remains anchored in the focus epithet and gains support from the adjacent removal of harm and protective forgiveness; downstream prose should qualify it as an aftercare analogy, not lexical replacement or veterinary scene.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The closing حَلِيمٌ has a branch involving removal of an irritant and calming care, which can modify how the satisfying entry is maintained.

activation_trace.role: Tending away an attached irritant and soothing the subject supplies an active-care image for forbearance rather than mere nonreaction.
The entered interior is the focus setting whose habitability this proposed aftercare preserves.
Acceptance is the recipient-side sign that calming care has made the inside genuinely livable.
Removal of what harms and investiture with safety provides adjacent support for care that actively restores comfort.
Protective covering of fault supplies shelter from lingering effects after conflict and supports a habitable final state.

changed_reading.before: Forbearance means only that punishment is withheld before admission.
changed_reading.after: Forbearance may also suggest active aftercare that removes lingering harm, calms the admitted, and keeps their new inside satisfying.

strongest_changes: The two earlier admissions into gardens give the unnamed مُدْخَل a strong spatial horizon while its altered wording foregrounds recipient fit.
Forced exit from dwellings and the immediately preceding interrupted migration turn admission into restorative emplacement and completed arrival.
Repeated divine postponement and the following retaliation-pardon sequence make عَلِيمٌ حَلِيمٌ govern timing, restraint, and de-escalated restoration rather than serve as a generic close.
The adjacent reciprocal insertion of night and day keeps an exploratory process-reading alive: entry may be staged integration as well as threshold crossing.
summary.what_was_special: The doubled entry root, the unnamed cognate noun, the recipients' own satisfaction, and the Knowing-Forbearing close form an unusually permeable focus construction. Context can specify gardens, sanctuary hospitality, repaired dwelling, journey completion, inward settling, or gradual transition without requiring those readings to collapse into one another.
remaining_uncertainties: مُدْخَلًا can weight destination, act, or manner differently; the trace preserves all three rather than resolving the grammar prematurely.
The garden repetitions are the strongest locative cue, but it remains uncertain whether they fully identify the focus destination or only orient it.
The night-day interleaving, social incorporation, second-watering, and active-aftercare readings are anchored but branch-distant and require explicit qualification in downstream prose.
